options.A: A mobile payment app enables payments; a mobile banking app provides access to banking services such as balance enquiry and transfers
options.B: A mobile payment app provides banking services; a mobile banking app enables payments
options.D: A mobile payment app is for businesses only; a mobile banking app is for individuals only

questions.explanation: A mobile payment app enables payments. A mobile banking app provides access to banking services such as balance enquiry, transfers, bill payments and account management.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a point-to-point connection and a multipoint connection?

options.A: A point-to-point connection links two devices directly; a multipoint connection links multiple devices to a shared medium
options.B: A point-to-point connection links multiple devices; a multipoint connection links two devices
options.D: A point-to-point connection is for wireless only; a multipoint connection is for wired only

questions.explanation: A point-to-point connection links two devices directly. A multipoint connection links multiple devices to a shared medium.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database transaction and a database operation?

options.A: A transaction is a logical unit of work that may contain one or more operations; an operation is a single action performed on the database
options.B: A transaction is a single action; an operation is a logical unit of work
options.D: A transaction is for cloud only; an operation is for local only

questions.explanation: A transaction is a logical unit of database work that may contain one or more operations and is treated as a single unit for consistency and reliability. An operation is a single action performed on the database.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a sound card and a graphics card?

options.A: A sound card processes audio; a graphics card processes and renders graphics
options.B: A sound card processes graphics; a graphics card processes audio
options.D: A sound card is for storage only; a graphics card is for processing only

questions.explanation: A sound card processes audio. A graphics card processes and renders graphics.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a firewall rule and an access control list (ACL)?

options.A: A firewall rule filters network traffic based on defined criteria; an ACL specifies which users or systems are granted or denied access to resources
options.B: A firewall rule specifies user access; an ACL filters network traffic
options.D: A firewall rule is for hardware only; an ACL is for software only

questions.explanation: A firewall rule filters network traffic based on defined criteria. An ACL specifies which users or systems are granted or denied access to resources.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a DNS query and a DNS response?

options.A: A DNS query is a request to resolve a domain name; a DNS response contains the resolved IP address or other information
options.B: A DNS query contains the resolved IP address; a DNS response is a request
options.D: A DNS query is for email only; a DNS response is for websites only

questions.explanation: A DNS query is a request to resolve a domain name. A DNS response contains the resolved IP address or other information.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud workload and a cloud service?

options.A: A cloud workload is an application or set of processes running in the cloud; a cloud service is a service provided by a cloud provider
options.B: A cloud workload is a service provided by a provider; a cloud service is an application running in the cloud
options.D: A cloud workload is for storage only; a cloud service is for computing only

questions.explanation: A cloud workload is an application or set of processes running in the cloud. A cloud service is a service provided by a cloud provider.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile network and a wireless network?

options.A: A mobile network is a cellular telecommunications system; a wireless network is any network that uses wireless communication
options.B: A mobile network is any wireless network; a wireless network is a cellular system
options.D: A mobile network is for data only; a wireless network is for voice only

questions.explanation: A mobile network is a wireless telecommunications system that connects mobile devices to voice, messaging and data services. A wireless network is any network that uses wireless communication.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a single-mode fibre and a multi-mode fibre?

options.A: Single-mode fibre has a small core and supports long-distance transmission; multi-mode fibre has a larger core and is used for shorter distances
options.B: Single-mode fibre has a larger core; multi-mode fibre has a smaller core
options.D: Single-mode fibre is for wireless only; multi-mode fibre is for wired only

questions.explanation: Single-mode fibre has a small core and supports long-distance transmission. Multi-mode fibre has a larger core and is used for shorter distances.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database index and a database key?

options.A: An index is a data structure that helps locate rows efficiently; a key is a column or set of columns used to uniquely identify or reference rows
options.B: An index uniquely identifies rows; a key helps locate rows
options.D: An index is for storage only; a key is for querying only

questions.explanation: An index is a data structure that helps a database locate rows more efficiently. A key is a column or set of columns used to uniquely identify or reference rows.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a network interface card (NIC) and a modem?

options.A: A NIC connects a computer to a network; a modem modulates and demodulates signals for data transmission over a communication medium
options.B: A NIC modulates signals; a modem connects to a network
options.D: A NIC is for wireless only; a modem is for wired only

questions.explanation: A network interface card (NIC) connects a computer to a network. A modem is a device that modulates and demodulates signals or otherwise adapts digital data to the transmission system used by an access network.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a man-in-the-middle attack and a denial-of-service attack?

options.A: A man-in-the-middle attack intercepts communication between two parties; a denial-of-service attack disrupts services by overwhelming a system with requests
options.B: A man-in-the-middle attack disrupts services; a denial-of-service attack intercepts communication
options.D: A man-in-the-middle attack is for hardware only; a denial-of-service attack is for software only

questions.explanation: A man-in-the-middle attack intercepts communication between two parties. A denial-of-service attack disrupts services by overwhelming a system with requests.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a public IP address and a private IP address?

options.A: A public IP address is globally routable on the Internet; a private IP address is used within a private network and not directly routable on the Internet
options.B: A public IP address is used within a private network; a private IP address is globally routable
options.D: A public IP address is for email only; a private IP address is for websites only

questions.explanation: A public IP address is globally routable on the Internet. A private IP address is used within a private network and not directly routable on the Internet.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud storage bucket and a cloud storage object?

options.A: A bucket is a container for storing objects; an object is a unit of data stored in a bucket
options.B: A bucket is a unit of data; an object is a container
options.D: A bucket is for computing only; an object is for storage only

questions.explanation: A bucket is a container for storing objects. An object is a unit of data stored in a bucket.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile sensor and a mobile actuator?

options.A: A sensor detects physical conditions; an actuator performs actions or controls mechanisms
options.B: A sensor performs actions; an actuator detects conditions
options.D: A sensor is for storage only; an actuator is for processing only

questions.explanation: A sensor detects physical conditions. An actuator performs actions or controls mechanisms.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a synchronous transmission and an asynchronous transmission?

options.A: Synchronous transmission sends data in blocks with timing signals; asynchronous transmission sends data one character at a time with start and stop bits
options.B: Synchronous transmission sends data one character at a time; asynchronous transmission sends data in blocks
options.D: Synchronous transmission is for wireless only; asynchronous transmission is for wired only

questions.explanation: Synchronous transmission sends data in blocks with timing signals. Asynchronous transmission sends data one character at a time with start and stop bits.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database constraint and a database trigger?

options.A: A constraint enforces rules on data; a trigger automatically executes in response to a specified event
options.B: A constraint executes in response to an event; a trigger enforces rules on data
options.D: A constraint is for cloud only; a trigger is for local only

questions.explanation: A constraint enforces rules on data, such as uniqueness or referential integrity. A trigger automatically executes in response to a specified event.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a solid-state drive and a hard disk drive in terms of moving parts?

options.A: An SSD has no moving mechanical parts; an HDD uses rotating magnetic platters and mechanical components
options.B: An SSD uses rotating platters; an HDD has no moving parts
options.D: An SSD is for storage only; an HDD is for processing only

questions.explanation: An SSD stores data in flash memory and has no moving mechanical parts. An HDD stores data magnetically on rotating platters and uses mechanical read/write components.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a privacy breach and a security breach?

options.A: A privacy breach involves unauthorised access to personal information; a security breach involves unauthorised access to systems or data
options.B: A privacy breach involves unauthorised access to systems; a security breach involves personal information
options.D: A privacy breach is for hardware only; a security breach is for software only

questions.explanation: A privacy breach involves unauthorised access to personal information. A security breach involves unauthorised access to systems or data.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a proxy and a VPN?

options.A: A proxy acts as an intermediary for specific applications; a VPN creates a protected logical connection for all traffic between endpoints
options.B: A proxy creates a protected connection; a VPN acts as an intermediary
options.D: A proxy is for hardware only; a VPN is for software only

questions.explanation: A proxy acts as an intermediary for specific applications. VPN stands for Virtual Private Network. It creates a protected logical connection over another network, often using encryption to secure traffic between endpoints.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud service catalogue and a cloud service portfolio?

options.A: A service catalogue lists available cloud services; a service portfolio includes all services managed by a provider, including those in development
options.B: A service catalogue includes all services; a service portfolio lists available services
options.D: A service catalogue is for storage only; a service portfolio is for computing only

questions.explanation: A service catalogue lists available cloud services. A service portfolio includes all services managed by a provider, including those in development.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile network and a mobile internet?

options.A: A mobile network provides voice, messaging and data services; mobile internet refers specifically to internet access through mobile networks
options.B: A mobile network provides internet access only; mobile internet provides voice and messaging
options.D: A mobile network is for hardware only; mobile internet is for software only

questions.explanation: A mobile network is a wireless telecommunications system that connects mobile devices to voice, messaging and data services. Mobile internet refers specifically to internet access through mobile networks.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a frequency band and a channel?

options.A: A frequency band is a range of frequencies; a channel is a specific frequency or range used for communication
options.B: A frequency band is a specific frequency; a channel is a range of frequencies
options.D: A frequency band is for wireless only; a channel is for wired only

questions.explanation: A frequency band is a range of frequencies. A channel is a specific frequency or range used for communication.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database schema and a database subschema?

options.A: A schema is the logical structure of the entire database; a subschema is a subset of the schema for a specific application or user
options.B: A schema is a subset for a specific user; a subschema is the entire database structure
options.D: A schema is for cloud only; a subschema is for local only

questions.explanation: A database schema is the logical structure or blueprint of a database. A subschema is a subset of the schema for a specific application or user.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a port and a connector?

options.A: A port is a interface on a computer for connecting devices; a connector is the physical plug at the end of a cable
options.B: A port is the physical plug; a connector is the interface on a computer
options.D: A port is for storage only; a connector is for processing only

questions.explanation: A port is an interface on a computer for connecting devices. A connector is the physical plug at the end of a cable.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a keylogger and spyware?

options.A: A keylogger records keystrokes; spyware secretly gathers information about a user's activities
options.B: A keylogger gathers information; spyware records keystrokes
options.D: A keylogger is for hardware only; spyware is for software only

questions.explanation: A keylogger records keystrokes. Spyware secretly gathers information about a user's activities. A keylogger is a type of spyware.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between an HTTP request and an HTTP response?

options.A: An HTTP request is sent by a client to a server; an HTTP response is sent by a server to a client
options.B: An HTTP request is sent by a server; an HTTP response is sent by a client
options.D: An HTTP request is for email only; an HTTP response is for websites only

questions.explanation: An HTTP request is sent by a client to a server. An HTTP response is sent by a server to a client.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud API and a cloud CLI?

options.A: A cloud API allows programmatic interaction with cloud services; a cloud CLI allows command-line interaction with cloud services
options.B: A cloud API allows command-line interaction; a cloud CLI allows programmatic interaction
options.D: A cloud API is for storage only; a cloud CLI is for computing only

questions.explanation: A cloud API allows programmatic interaction with cloud services. A cloud CLI allows command-line interaction with cloud services.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile OS and a mobile app?

options.A: A mobile OS is system software that manages mobile device resources; a mobile app is software designed to perform specific tasks for users
options.B: A mobile OS performs specific tasks; a mobile app manages device resources
options.D: A mobile OS is for storage only; a mobile app is for processing only

questions.explanation: A mobile operating system manages mobile device resources. A mobile app is software designed to run on a mobile device such as a smartphone or tablet.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a duplex communication and a simplex communication?

options.A: Duplex communication allows data flow in both directions; simplex communication allows data flow in one direction only
options.B: Duplex communication allows data flow in one direction; simplex communication allows data flow in both directions
options.D: Duplex communication is for wireless only; simplex communication is for wired only

questions.explanation: Simplex communication allows data to flow in one direction only. Half-duplex communication allows data to flow in both directions, but not at the same time. Full-duplex communication allows data to flow in both directions simultaneously.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database administrator and a database developer?

options.A: A DBA manages database installation, configuration, security and performance; a database developer designs and implements database structures and queries
options.B: A DBA designs database structures; a database developer manages database performance
options.D: A DBA is for cloud only; a database developer is for local only

questions.explanation: A DBA is a professional responsible for database installation, configuration, security, performance, backup, recovery and ongoing administration. A database developer designs and implements database structures and queries.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a monitor and a projector?

options.A: A monitor displays information on a screen; a projector displays information by projecting it onto a surface
options.B: A monitor projects information; a projector displays on a screen
options.D: A monitor is for storage only; a projector is for processing only

questions.explanation: A monitor is a visual output device that displays text, images, video and graphical information. A projector displays information by projecting it onto a surface.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a whitelist and a blacklist in security?

options.A: A whitelist allows only specified items; a blacklist blocks specified items
options.B: A whitelist blocks specified items; a blacklist allows only specified items
options.D: A whitelist is for hardware only; a blacklist is for software only

questions.explanation: A whitelist allows only specified items. A blacklist blocks specified items.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web cookie and a web beacon?

options.A: A cookie is a small piece of data stored by a browser; a web beacon is a small object embedded in a web page or email used to track user behaviour
options.B: A cookie tracks user behaviour; a web beacon stores data in a browser
options.D: A cookie is for hardware only; a web beacon is for software only

questions.explanation: A cookie is a small piece of data stored by a browser at a website's request. A web beacon is a small object embedded in a web page or email used to track user behaviour.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud subscription and a cloud pay-as-you-go model?

options.A: A subscription involves regular fixed payments; pay-as-you-go involves usage-based billing
options.B: A subscription involves usage-based billing; pay-as-you-go involves fixed payments
options.D: A subscription is for storage only; pay-as-you-go is for computing only

questions.explanation: A subscription involves regular fixed payments. Pay-as-you-go involves usage-based billing.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile notification and a mobile alert?

options.A: A notification informs users about events or updates; an alert is a notification that requires immediate attention
options.B: A notification requires immediate attention; an alert informs about events
options.D: A notification is for storage only; an alert is for processing only

questions.explanation: A notification informs users about events or updates. An alert is a notification that requires immediate attention.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a copper cable and an optical fibre cable?

options.A: A copper cable transmits electrical signals; an optical fibre cable transmits light pulses
options.B: A copper cable transmits light pulses; an optical fibre cable transmits electrical signals
options.D: A copper cable is for wireless only; an optical fibre cable is for wired only

questions.explanation: A copper cable transmits electrical signals. An optical fibre cable transmits information as pulses of light through thin strands of glass or plastic fibre.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data lake?

options.A: A database stores structured data for operational use; a data lake stores raw data in its native format for analysis
options.B: A database stores raw data; a data lake stores structured data
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data lake is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data stored and managed for operational use. A data lake stores raw data in its native format for analysis.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a desktop computer and a laptop computer?

options.A: A desktop computer is designed for stationary use; a laptop computer is portable and includes a built-in display, keyboard and battery
options.B: A desktop computer is portable; a laptop computer is designed for stationary use
options.D: A desktop computer is for storage only; a laptop computer is for processing only

questions.explanation: A desktop computer is designed for stationary use. A laptop computer is portable and includes a built-in display, keyboard and battery.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a software bug and a software vulnerability?

options.A: A bug is a flaw in software that may cause incorrect behaviour; a vulnerability is a weakness that can be exploited to compromise security
options.B: A bug is a security weakness; a vulnerability is a flaw causing incorrect behaviour
options.D: A bug is for hardware only; a vulnerability is for software only

questions.explanation: A bug is a flaw in software that may cause incorrect behaviour. A vulnerability is a weakness that can be exploited to compromise security.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a session cookie and a persistent cookie?

options.A: A session cookie is stored temporarily and expires when the browser closes; a persistent cookie remains on the device for a specified period
options.B: A session cookie remains for a specified period; a persistent cookie expires when the browser closes
options.D: A session cookie is for hardware only; a persistent cookie is for software only

questions.explanation: A session cookie is stored temporarily and expires when the browser closes. A persistent cookie remains on the device for a specified period.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud region and a cloud edge location?

options.A: A cloud region is a geographic area containing data centres; a cloud edge location is a site closer to end users for low-latency services
options.B: A cloud region is closer to end users; a cloud edge location is a geographic area
options.D: A cloud region is for storage only; a cloud edge location is for computing only

questions.explanation: A cloud region is a geographic area containing data centres. A cloud edge location is a site closer to end users for low-latency services.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile web app and a native mobile app?

options.A: A mobile web app runs in a browser; a native mobile app is installed on the device and runs directly on the mobile OS
options.B: A mobile web app is installed on the device; a native mobile app runs in a browser
options.D: A mobile web app is for Android only; a native mobile app is for iOS only

questions.explanation: A mobile web app runs in a browser. A native mobile app is installed on the device and runs directly on the mobile OS.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a base station and a mobile switching centre?

options.A: A base station communicates wirelessly with mobile devices; a mobile switching centre manages call routing and connections
options.B: A base station manages call routing; a mobile switching centre communicates wirelessly
options.D: A base station is for storage only; a mobile switching centre is for processing only

questions.explanation: A base station communicates wirelessly with mobile devices. A mobile switching centre manages call routing and connections.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data mart?

options.A: A database stores operational data; a data mart is a subset of a data warehouse focused on a specific business area
options.B: A database is a subset of a data warehouse; a data mart stores operational data
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data mart is for local only

questions.explanation: A database stores operational data. A data mart is a subset of a data warehouse focused on a specific business area.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a USB port and an HDMI port?

options.A: A USB port connects peripherals and storage devices; an HDMI port transmits high-definition audio and video signals
options.B: A USB port transmits video signals; an HDMI port connects peripherals
options.D: A USB port is for storage only; an HDMI port is for processing only

questions.explanation: A USB port connects peripherals and storage devices. An HDMI port transmits high-definition audio and video signals.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security audit and a security assessment?

options.A: A security audit is a formal examination against standards; a security assessment is a broader evaluation of security posture
options.B: A security audit is a broad evaluation; a security assessment is a formal examination
options.D: A security audit is for hardware only; a security assessment is for software only

questions.explanation: A security audit is a formal examination against standards. A security assessment is a broader evaluation of security posture.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web cache and a proxy cache?

options.A: A web cache stores copies of web resources for faster access; a proxy cache is a cache implemented on a proxy server
options.B: A web cache is implemented on a proxy server; a proxy cache stores copies of web resources
options.D: A web cache is for hardware only; a proxy cache is for software only

questions.explanation: A web cache stores copies of web resources for faster access. A proxy cache is a cache implemented on a proxy server.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between cloud orchestration and cloud automation?

options.A: Cloud automation performs individual tasks automatically; cloud orchestration coordinates multiple automated tasks into workflows
options.B: Cloud automation coordinates workflows; cloud orchestration performs individual tasks
options.D: Cloud automation is for storage only; cloud orchestration is for computing only

questions.explanation: Cloud automation performs individual tasks automatically. Cloud orchestration coordinates multiple automated tasks into workflows.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile device and a mobile computer?

options.A: A mobile device is a portable electronic device; a mobile computer is a portable computing device with processing capabilities
options.B: A mobile device has processing capabilities; a mobile computer is a portable electronic device
options.D: A mobile device is for storage only; a mobile computer is for processing only

questions.explanation: A mobile device is a portable electronic device. A mobile computer is a portable computing device with processing capabilities.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a wireless access point and a wireless router?

options.A: A wireless access point provides wireless connectivity to a network; a wireless router combines routing and wireless access point functions
options.B: A wireless access point routes data; a wireless router provides wireless connectivity
options.D: A wireless access point is for storage only; a wireless router is for processing only

questions.explanation: A wireless access point provides wireless devices with connectivity to a local area network. A wireless router combines routing and wireless access point functions.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data set?

options.A: A database is an organised collection of related data managed by a DBMS; a data set is a collection of data often used for analysis
options.B: A database is a collection of data for analysis; a data set is managed by a DBMS
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data set is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data stored and managed so that it can be accessed, retrieved, updated and analysed efficiently. A data set is a collection of data often used for analysis.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a laptop and a tablet?

options.A: A laptop has a physical keyboard and typically more processing power; a tablet is a touchscreen device that is more portable
options.B: A laptop is a touchscreen device; a tablet has a physical keyboard
options.D: A laptop is for storage only; a tablet is for processing only

questions.explanation: A laptop has a physical keyboard and typically more processing power. A tablet is a touchscreen device that is more portable.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security incident and a security event?

options.A: A security event is any observable occurrence in a system; a security incident is an event that indicates a possible security breach
options.B: A security event indicates a breach; a security incident is any observable occurrence
options.D: A security event is for hardware only; a security incident is for software only

questions.explanation: A security event is any observable occurrence in a system. A security incident is an event that indicates a possible security breach.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web portal and a website?

options.A: A web portal is a website that aggregates information from multiple sources; a website is a collection of related web pages
options.B: A web portal is a collection of web pages; a website aggregates information from multiple sources
options.D: A web portal is for storage only; a website is for processing only

questions.explanation: A web portal is a website that aggregates information from multiple sources. A website is a collection of related web pages and resources generally published under a common domain name.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between cloud storage and cloud computing?

options.A: Cloud storage is a service that stores digital data on remote infrastructure; cloud computing provides on-demand access to a shared pool of computing resources
options.B: Cloud storage provides computing resources; cloud computing stores digital data
options.D: Cloud storage is for computing only; cloud computing is for storage only

questions.explanation: Cloud storage is a service that stores digital data on remote infrastructure and makes it accessible over a network. Cloud computing is a model for providing on-demand network access to a shared pool of configurable computing resources.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile phone and a smartphone?

options.A: A mobile phone is a portable telephone; a smartphone has advanced computing capabilities, an operating system and the ability to run applications
options.B: A mobile phone has advanced capabilities; a smartphone is a basic telephone
options.D: A mobile phone is for storage only; a smartphone is for processing only

questions.explanation: A mobile phone is a portable telephone. A smartphone is a mobile phone with advanced computing capabilities, an operating system, internet connectivity and the ability to run applications.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a LAN and a WAN?

options.A: A LAN covers a small geographic area; a WAN covers a large geographic area
options.B: A LAN covers a large geographic area; a WAN covers a small geographic area
options.D: A LAN is for storage only; a WAN is for processing only

questions.explanation: A LAN (Local Area Network) covers a small geographic area. A WAN (Wide Area Network) covers a large geographic area.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data warehouse?

options.A: A database is designed for operational transaction processing; a data warehouse is designed for analytical reporting and decision support
options.B: A database is for analytical reporting; a data warehouse is for operational processing
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data warehouse is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data stored and managed so that it can be accessed, retrieved, updated and analysed efficiently. A data warehouse is a centralised repository designed to store integrated historical data for reporting, analysis and decision support.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a keyboard and a keypad?

options.A: A keyboard has a full set of keys for typing; a keypad has a smaller set of keys often used for numeric input
options.B: A keyboard has a smaller set of keys; a keypad has a full set of keys
options.D: A keyboard is for storage only; a keypad is for processing only

questions.explanation: A keyboard is an input device used to enter letters, numbers, symbols and commands. A keypad has a smaller set of keys often used for numeric input.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security policy and a security procedure?

options.A: A security policy defines rules and principles; a security procedure defines step-by-step instructions for implementing the policy
options.B: A security policy defines step-by-step instructions; a security procedure defines rules and principles
options.D: A security policy is for hardware only; a security procedure is for software only

questions.explanation: A security policy defines rules and principles. A security procedure defines step-by-step instructions for implementing the policy.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between cloud infrastructure and cloud platform?

options.A: Cloud infrastructure provides fundamental computing resources such as virtual machines, storage and networking; cloud platform provides a managed environment for developing and deploying applications
options.B: Cloud infrastructure provides development tools; cloud platform provides virtual machines
options.D: Cloud infrastructure is for storage only; cloud platform is for computing only

questions.explanation: IaaS provides fundamental computing resources such as virtual machines, storage and networking. PaaS provides a managed platform, including runtime environments and development tools.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile app and a mobile widget?

options.A: A mobile app is a full application; a mobile widget is a small application or interface element that provides quick access to information or functions
options.B: A mobile app is a small interface element; a mobile widget is a full application
options.D: A mobile app is for storage only; a mobile widget is for processing only

questions.explanation: A mobile app is software designed to run on a mobile device. A mobile widget is a small application or interface element that provides quick access to information or functions.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a hub and a switch?

options.A: A hub broadcasts data to all connected devices; a switch forwards data only to the intended device
options.B: A hub forwards data to the intended device; a switch broadcasts data to all devices
options.D: A hub is for wireless only; a switch is for wired only

questions.explanation: A hub broadcasts data to all connected devices. A switch forwards data only to the intended device.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a spreadsheet in terms of data volume?

options.A: A database is designed to handle large volumes of structured data; a spreadsheet is typically used for smaller datasets
options.B: A database is for smaller datasets; a spreadsheet is for large volumes
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a spreadsheet is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is designed to store, manage and query large volumes of structured data. A spreadsheet is typically used for smaller datasets and calculations.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a touchpad and a mouse?

options.A: A touchpad is a built-in pointing device using touch gestures; a mouse is an external pointing device moved across a surface
options.B: A touchpad is an external device; a mouse is built-in
options.D: A touchpad is for storage only; a mouse is for processing only

questions.explanation: A touchpad is a built-in pointing device using touch gestures. A mouse is an external pointing device moved across a surface.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security control and a security countermeasure?

options.A: A security control is a safeguard or mechanism to protect assets; a security countermeasure is a specific action taken to counter a threat
options.B: A security control is a specific action; a security countermeasure is a safeguard
options.D: A security control is for hardware only; a security countermeasure is for software only

questions.explanation: A security control is a safeguard or mechanism to protect assets. A security countermeasure is a specific action taken to counter a threat.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web service and a web application?

options.A: A web service provides machine-to-machine interaction over a network; a web application provides interactive functionality to users through a browser
options.B: A web service provides interactive functionality; a web application provides machine-to-machine interaction
options.D: A web service is for storage only; a web application is for processing only

questions.explanation: A web service provides machine-to-machine interaction over a network. A web application provides interactive functionality to users through a browser.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between cloud infrastructure and cloud architecture?

options.A: Cloud infrastructure refers to the physical and virtual resources; cloud architecture refers to the design and structure of cloud systems
options.B: Cloud infrastructure refers to the design; cloud architecture refers to the resources
options.D: Cloud infrastructure is for storage only; cloud architecture is for computing only

questions.explanation: Cloud infrastructure refers to the physical and virtual resources. Cloud architecture refers to the design and structure of cloud systems.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile app permission and a mobile app privilege?

options.A: A permission is authorisation granted to an app to access device features or data; a privilege is a right or access level granted to a user or process
options.B: A permission is a right granted to a user; a privilege is authorisation granted to an app
options.D: A permission is for storage only; a privilege is for processing only

questions.explanation: An app permission is authorisation granted to an application to access a device feature or data. A privilege is a right or access level granted to a user or process.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a unicast transmission and a broadcast transmission?

options.A: Unicast sends data to a single destination; broadcast sends data to all devices on a network
options.B: Unicast sends data to all devices; broadcast sends data to a single destination
options.D: Unicast is for wireless only; broadcast is for wired only

questions.explanation: Unicast sends data to a single destination. Broadcast sends data to all devices on a network.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data model?

options.A: A database is an organised collection of data; a data model is an abstract representation of data structures and relationships
options.B: A database is an abstract representation; a data model is an organised collection
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data model is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data. A data model is an abstract representation of data structures and relationships.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a joystick and a gamepad?

options.A: A joystick is a vertical lever input device; a gamepad is a handheld controller with buttons and directional controls
options.B: A joystick is a handheld controller; a gamepad is a vertical lever
options.D: A joystick is for storage only; a gamepad is for processing only

questions.explanation: A joystick is a vertical lever input device. A gamepad is a handheld controller with buttons and directional controls.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security breach and a security incident?

options.A: A security incident is an event that indicates a possible security breach; a security breach is a confirmed incident where security has been compromised
options.B: A security incident is a confirmed breach; a security breach is a possible incident
options.D: A security incident is for hardware only; a security breach is for software only

questions.explanation: A security incident is an event that indicates a possible security breach. A security breach is a confirmed incident where security has been compromised.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web feed and a web stream?

options.A: A web feed provides updates in a structured format for subscription; a web stream delivers continuous media content
options.B: A web feed delivers continuous media; a web stream provides structured updates
options.D: A web feed is for storage only; a web stream is for processing only

questions.explanation: A web feed provides updates in a structured format for subscription. A web stream delivers continuous media content.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a cloud tenant and a cloud user?

options.A: A cloud tenant is an organisation or account that uses cloud services; a cloud user is an individual who accesses cloud services
options.B: A cloud tenant is an individual user; a cloud user is an organisation
options.D: A cloud tenant is for storage only; a cloud user is for processing only

questions.explanation: A cloud tenant is an organisation or account that uses cloud services. A cloud user is an individual who accesses cloud services.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile app store and a mobile app marketplace?

options.A: An app store is a platform for distributing apps; an app marketplace is a broader platform that may include apps, services and other digital content
options.B: An app store is a broader platform; an app marketplace is for apps only
options.D: An app store is for Android only; an app marketplace is for iOS only

questions.explanation: An app store is a platform for distributing apps. An app marketplace is a broader platform that may include apps, services and other digital content.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a wireless LAN and a wireless WAN?

options.A: A wireless LAN covers a small area; a wireless WAN covers a large area
options.B: A wireless LAN covers a large area; a wireless WAN covers a small area
options.D: A wireless LAN is for storage only; a wireless WAN is for processing only

questions.explanation: A wireless LAN covers a small area. A wireless WAN covers a large area.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a database and a data repository?

options.A: A database is an organised collection of related data; a data repository is a central location where data is stored and maintained
options.B: A database is a central location; a data repository is an organised collection
options.D: A database is for cloud only; a data repository is for local only

questions.explanation: A database is an organised collection of related data. A data repository is a central location where data is stored and maintained.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a microphone and a speaker?

options.A: A microphone is an input device that captures sound; a speaker is an output device that produces sound
options.B: A microphone is an output device; a speaker is an input device
options.D: A microphone is for storage only; a speaker is for processing only

questions.explanation: A microphone is an input device that captures sound. A speaker is an output device that produces sound.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.chapter: Cyber Safety and Responsible Use of IT
questions.question: What is the difference between a security framework and a security standard?

options.A: A security framework provides a structured approach to managing security; a security standard specifies detailed requirements
options.B: A security framework specifies detailed requirements; a security standard provides a structured approach
options.D: A security framework is for hardware only; a security standard is for software only

questions.explanation: A security framework provides a structured approach to managing security. A security standard specifies detailed requirements.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a web API and a web service?

options.A: A web API is an interface for programmatic interaction with web resources; a web service is a service provided over a network using standard protocols
options.B: A web API is a service provided over a network; a web service is an interface for programmatic interaction
options.D: A web API is for storage only; a web service is for processing only

questions.explanation: A web API is an interface for programmatic interaction with web resources. A web service is a service provided over a network using standard protocols.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between cloud cost optimisation and cloud cost management?

options.A: Cloud cost optimisation is the process of reducing costs while maintaining performance; cloud cost management is the broader process of monitoring and controlling cloud costs
options.B: Cloud cost optimisation monitors costs; cloud cost management reduces costs
options.D: Cloud cost optimisation is for storage only; cloud cost management is for computing only

questions.explanation: Cloud cost optimisation is the process of reducing costs while maintaining performance. Cloud cost management is the broader process of monitoring and controlling cloud costs.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a mobile app and a mobile game?

options.A: A mobile app is software designed to perform tasks; a mobile game is a type of app designed for entertainment
options.B: A mobile app is for entertainment; a mobile game performs tasks
options.D: A mobile app is for storage only; a mobile game is for processing only

questions.explanation: A mobile app is software designed to perform tasks. A mobile game is a type of app designed for entertainment.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the difference between a wired network and a wireless network?

options.A: A wired network uses physical cables; a wireless network uses radio waves or other wireless media
options.B: A wired network uses radio waves; a wireless network uses cables
options.D: A wired network is for storage only; a wireless network is for processing only

questions.explanation: A wired network uses physical cables. A wireless network uses radio waves or other wireless media.
